projects.name: StarRocks
projects.description: StarRocks is a next-generation sub-second MPP OLAP database for full-analytics scenarios, supporting multi-table joins, real-time aggregation, and direct lakehouse query execution on Apache Iceberg, Hudi, and Delta Lake.
projects.best_for: Sub-second multi-table relational joins, denormalized real-time dashboards, and vectorized MPP Iceberg lakehouse query acceleration

projects.name: Apache Doris
projects.description: Apache Doris is an easy-to-use, high-performance and real-time analytical database based on MPP architecture, known for high query performance and real-time data ingestion.
projects.best_for: Real-time high-concurrency point queries, ad-hoc OLAP exploration, inverted index search, and flexible partial column updates

projects.name: ClickHouse
projects.description: ClickHouse is a free, fast, open-source columnar database management system for real-time analytical reporting using SQL.
projects.best_for: Ultra-fast single-table aggregations, time-series telemetry metrics, log ingestion, and high-throughput analytical scanning

projects.name: DuckDB
projects.description: DuckDB is an in-process SQL OLAP database management system designed for fast analytical queries on local files and cloud object storage.
projects.best_for: Embedded analytical querying, zero-copy Arrow data science pipelines, serverless single-node ETL, and direct Parquet querying
